Keyboard & mouse: WASD move  Mouse look  LMB attack  F/MMB heavy attack  RMB block
Q switch weapon  R mount/dismount  Space dodge  Shift sprint  Wheel zoom  1/2/3 retinue orders

Gamepad: left stick move  right stick look  ZR/R attack  Y heavy attack  ZL/L block
X switch weapon  − mount/dismount  B/A dodge  click left stick to sprint  D-pad retinue orders  + pause

Moves: tap attack standing or advancing = three-hit combo (the last hit is stronger)
Hold left/right while striking = sweep to that side  hold back = change-up  attack while sprinting = lunging thrust
Heavy attacks break a shield guard; a bow aims itself at the enemy straight ahead of the camera
Striking at speed on horseback = charge (damage +30%, more knockback)
Sieges: walk into the wall at the foot of a ladder to climb; ramps on the inner side lead down into the city; the gate can be hacked down
Switching weapons swaps main and off hand; enemies you beat yourself may drop weapons and horses
